title: AI Agent Application for Multi-Branch Inventory Management in SMEs
description: Developed an AI-powered supply chain management system with workflow automation, real-time analytics, and a Vietnamese NLP chatbot for inventory management, demand forecasting, supplier evaluation, and decision support.

title: Digital Marketing in the Gen Z Fashion Industry
description: Built an automated multi-platform social media analytics pipeline to collect, process, and analyze data from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, generating insights on Gen Z fashion brands, engagement trends, and content performance for data-driven marketing decisions.

title: Behavior Tracking System
description: Built a real-time concentration tracking system with eye/mouth detection, focus scoring, and alert notifications using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe.

title: Borrowing & Returning Item Management System for Clubs/Schools
description: Designed system diagrams and built a full prototype for an equipment borrowing/return management system using Appsmith (UI/UX) and Strapi (backend), supporting both students and administrators, with integrated data visualization (charts, metrics) to enable faster decision-making.
